name: Receipts on the ink desk
description: Evidence prints onto a lit ink desk above his face, each line and figure landing on the word that names it, states dissolving, no camera move.

rated.words: They're all approved. I don't actually think these are the problem. I think how we integrate title cards and real-world images and motion animation is the issue.
